title: Centered weighted composition operators on $L^2$-spaces revisited
summary: Centered weighted composition operators on $L^2$-spaces are characterized. The characterization is obtained without the assumption that the operator is a product of a multiplication and a composition operator. The concept of spectrally half-centered operators is introduced, and it is shown that unbounded weighted composition operators are spectrally half-centered provided their powers are closed and densely defined. A criteria for centered weighted shifts on directed trees of types I--IV are provided. Various examples are presented.
